verdict.rationale: The docs explicitly position the Sandbox SDK for running untrusted code securely in isolated environments, with each sandbox in its own VM or container (docs-34, docs-38, docs-50). It targets AI agents that need to execute code (docs-24) and adds controls such as outbound HTTP interception via Workers (docs-23) and per-session command timeouts (docs-19). A community commenter reports egress control is all-or-nothing (comm-2), but docs-23 partly addresses this, and no hands-on report contradicts the isolation claims. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on verification of the isolation boundary, documented per-sandbox CPU/memory resource limits, and fine-grained egress allowlisting.
